response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth across multiple domains, extensive experience in developer tooling (test runners, CI/CD, fluent-asserts), and clear leadership through workshops and open-source projects, but lacks explicit evidence of people management and organizational change leadership, which are critical for this role.
strengths: Proven track record in building developer tools (test runners, CI systems, code generators) with real-world impact.
Extensive hands-on experience across mobile, web, and embedded systems including iOS app maintenance and optimization.
Active contributor to open-source tooling and educator through workshops, demonstrating communication and mentorship skills.
concerns: No clear evidence of formal people management experience beyond technical leadership.
Lacks explicit experience leading organizational change or cross-team alignment at scale.
Mobile platform expertise is inferred from iOS app work but not documented as part of a large ecosystem or build/test infrastructure.
